'''Docking bay TH X-11-38''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] that was located within [[New Tayana]], a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[City/Legends|city]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] and [[Ttekket]] traveled to the city aboard a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Personal Luxury Yacht 3000|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]], and on arrival there they berthed their vessel in docking bay TH X-11-38.

==Behind the scenes==
Docking bay TH X-11-38 is one of many ''Star Wars'' [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter eggs]] named after [[George Lucas]]'s [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|first film]], ''[[THX]] [[1138 (disambiguation)|1138]]''.
